parameters.content:
## Speed-to-Lead: start here
Replies to every new lead in under a minute by text/WhatsApp and email, scores it with AI, logs it in Google Sheets, alerts you about hot leads and follows up twice if they go quiet.

**Setup (about 20 minutes)**
1. Copy the Google Sheet template (columns: lead_id, received_at, name, email, phone, source, message, score, temperature, summary, status, followups_sent, last_contact_at, notes). Name the tab `Leads`.
2. Open **Settings** and fill in your business details, sheet URL, booking link and phone numbers.
3. Connect credentials: OpenAI, Google Sheets, Gmail, Twilio.
4. Point your website form at the **New lead (webhook)** URL, or share the built-in form's URL.
5. Optional: add the **Booking made** URL as a Cal.com/Calendly webhook, and the **Lead texted back** URL as your Twilio number's "A message comes in" webhook.
6. Activate the workflow.

### 1. New lead
Clean up the details from any form → skip duplicates → AI scores the lead and writes a text + email → send both → save to the sheet → alert you if it's hot.
Text/email to the lead never block the rest: a typo in a phone number won't lose the lead.

### 2. Follow-ups (every hour)
Leads still marked `contacted` get follow-up 1 after 24h and follow-up 2 after 72h (change in Settings). After the last one the status becomes `no_response`.
To stop follow-ups for a lead, change its status in the sheet (e.g. `booked`, `replied`, `lost`).

### 3. Booked / replied
Bookings from Cal.com or Calendly mark the lead `booked`. Texts back to your Twilio number mark it `replied` (or `opted_out` for STOP) and are forwarded to your email. Either way, follow-ups stop.
